'''Gorvo''' was the pet [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] of the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] [[Nandina]] from the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was as fierce as his mistress and would defend her to the death.

==Behind the scenes==
Gorvo appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gorvo was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
